name: Brain & Nerves
description: Your brain, spinal cord and the nerves that connect them to everything else. Headaches, seizures, memory, movement and sensation live here.

name: Mind & Mood
description: Mental health conditions are health conditions. Mood, anxiety, attention, trauma and sleep disorders, with the treatments that work.

name: Eyes, Ears, Nose & Mouth
description: The senses and the structures of the head: vision, hearing, sinuses, teeth and gums.

name: Heart & Blood
description: The heart, blood vessels and blood itself: blood pressure, cholesterol, rhythm problems, clots and anemia.

name: Lungs & Breathing
description: Airways and lungs, from asthma and infections to sleep-related breathing problems.

name: Digestive System
description: Everything from the esophagus to the bowel, plus the liver, gallbladder and pancreas that support digestion.

name: Hormones & Metabolism
description: The endocrine glands and how your body makes and uses energy: diabetes, thyroid disease, weight and nutrient deficiencies.

name: Kidneys & Urinary
description: The kidneys, bladder and urinary tract: stones, infections, chronic kidney disease and bladder control.

name: Bones, Joints & Muscles
description: The musculoskeletal system: back pain, arthritis, osteoporosis, tendons and soft-tissue injuries.

name: Skin, Hair & Nails
description: Your largest organ and its accessories: acne, eczema, psoriasis, infections and skin cancer.

name: Immune System & Infections
description: Infections from the common cold to malaria, plus allergies and conditions where the immune system misfires.

name: Women's Reproductive Health
description: The uterus, ovaries, cervix and breasts: periods, hormones, fertility, menopause and the cancers screening can catch early.

name: Men's Reproductive Health
description: The prostate, testes and sexual function: enlarged prostate, erectile dysfunction, testosterone and prostate cancer.
